Backups and disaster recovery

Even if a server dies or ransomware strikes, data comes back within hours, and that has been tested in advance. An MVP in 1–3 weeks, from UZS 18 mln; the full version in 4–8 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Integrations

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Automated encrypted backups of databases and files, 1C included
  • An off-site copy in Uzbekistan
  • One full restore test
  • Alerts on failed backups
What the full version adds
  • A disaster recovery site
  • Recovery time and data-loss targets agreed and tested every quarter
  • Immutable backups against ransomware
  • Runbook and staff drill

What we need from you

  • Access to servers and accounts
  • A description of the current system
  • A technical contact

Questions

What does “Backups and disaster recovery” cost?
The MVP costs $1,500–4,000 (UZS 18–48.5 mln), the full version $5,000–14,000 (UZS 60–169 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Backups and disaster recovery” take?
The MVP takes 1–3 weeks, the full version 4–8 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts; A description of the current system; A technical contact.
